nodes.name: Theorem 1: Local Geometry Thm
nodes.statement:
Consider any 1-D differentiable function $f(x)$ around a local minima $\Bar{x}$, satisfying (i) $f^{(3)}(\Bar{x})\neq 0$, and (ii) $3[f^{(3)}]^2-f'' f^{(4)}>0$ at $\Bar{x}$. Then, there exists $\epsilon$ with sufficiently small $|\epsilon|$ and $\epsilon\cdot f^{(3)}>0$ such that: for any point $x_0$ between $\Bar{x}$ and $\bar{x} - \epsilon$, there exists a learning rate $\eta$ such that $F^2_\eta(x_0)=x_0$, and
\[
\frac{2}{f''(\Bar{x})}<\eta<\frac{2}{f''(\Bar{x})-\epsilon\cdot f^{(3)}(\Bar{x})}.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 1: High-order LG Lem
nodes.statement:
Consider any 1-D differentiable function $f(x)$ around a local minima $\Bar{x}$, satisfying that the lowest order non-zero derivative (except the $f''$) at $\Bar{x}$ is $f^{(k)}(\Bar{x})$ with $k\ge 4$. Then, there exists $\epsilon$ with sufficiently small $|\epsilon|$ such that: for any point $x_0$ between $\Bar{x}$ and $\Bar{x}-\epsilon$, and
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item if $k$ is odd and $\epsilon\cdot f^{(k)}(\Bar{x})>0, f^{(k+1)}(\Bar{x})<0$, 
        
        then there exists $\eta\in(\frac{2}{f''}, \frac{2}{f''-f^{(k)}\epsilon^{k-2}})$,
        \item if $k$ is even and $f^{(k)}(\Bar{x})<0$, then there exists $\eta\in(\frac{2}{f''}, \frac{2}{f''+f^{(k)}\epsilon^{k-2}})$,
    \end{enumerate}
    such that $F^2_\eta(x_0)=x_0$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2: 1-D case Thm
Theorem 6: LG for MF Thm
Proposition 1: g x -y ^2 Prop
nodes.statement: Consider a 1-D function $g(x)$ , and define the loss function $f$ as $f(x) = (g(x)-y)^2$. Assuming (i) $g'$ is not zero when $g(\Bar{x})=y$, (ii) $g'(\Bar{x})g^{(3)}(\Bar{x}) < 6[g''(\Bar{x})]^2$, then it satisfies the condition in Theorem~1 or Lemma~1 have a fixed point of $F^2_\eta$ around $\Bar{x}$.

nodes.name: Proposition 3: 2-D case Prop
Theorem 3: Balancing effect Thm
nodes.statement: For $f(x,y)=\frac{1}{2}\left(xy-\mu\right)^2$, consider GD with learning rate $\eta=K\cdot\frac{1}{\mu}$. Assume both $x$ and $y$ are always positive during the whole process $\{x_i,y_i\}_{i\ge 0}$. In this process, denote a series of all points with $xy>\mu$ as $\mathcal{P}=\{(x_i,y_i)|x_i y_i>\mu\}_{i\ge0}$. Then $|x-y|$ {\color{black}decays to 0} in $\mathcal{P}$, for any $1<K<1.5$.

nodes.name: Proposition 2: Composition rule of $g$ Prop
nodes.statement: Consider two 1-D functions $p,q$. Assume both $p(x),q(y)$ at $x=\Bar{x}, y=p(\Bar{x})$ satisfies the conditions of $g$ in Prop~1. Then $q(p(x))$ also satisfies the conditions to have a fixed point of $F^2_\eta$ around $x=\Bar{x}$.
